name: sales-email-knowledge-assistant
description: 销售邮件知识检索助手 - 基于 AdonisJS 6 + Vue 3 + PostgreSQL + Redis 的全栈 AI 辅助系统

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && node ace migration:fresh && node ace db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
